name: Sear And Stew Black Slow Cooker - 3.5L - Dishwasher Safe
description:
Morphy Richards Sear And Stew Black Slow Cooker - 3.5L - Dishwasher Safe

This one-stop-pot simplifies everything by allowing you to sear and slow-cook in a single pot.

With a light and durable aluminium pot, you no longer have to worry about serving cumbersome dishes at mealtime. You'll also benefit from three heat settings so you can easily customise your cooking settings. Plus, this hob proof cooking pot (not suitable for induction) is easy to clean as it is dishwasher-safe. Making every day meals has never been easier; trust the Sear & Stew 3.5L slow cooker to take care of all your culinary needs!
  • Depth: 33 CM
  • Height: 21.2 CM
  • Width: 26.3 CM
  • You can seamlessly sear meats to lock in those sumptuous flavours and juices before stewing them to perfection, all within the same pot.
  • This innovative feature streamlines the cooking process, minimising clean-up and maximising efficiency.
  • Please note, this cooking pot is not suitable for Induction hobs.
  • The Sear & Stew's cooking pot is not just about cooking efficiency ? it's also designed for convenience
  • With three distinct heat settings ? high, medium, or low ? you can tailor the cooking temperature to suit the specific needs of your recipe
  • Once dinner's done, just pop the pot in the dishwasher and enjoy more time savouring your culinary creation
